Gregorio Y. Zara was a Filipino scientist born in 1902 in Lipa, Batangas.
Zara invented thirty devices, including solar-powered devices and an airplane compass.
Zara's biggest invention was the video phone, invented in 1955.
The video phone was first shown at the New York World Fair and later used worldwide.
